body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001679754956125544521335670993920702576998311438502580295460327520162864548260325638826305656132844632274451316908586220972070448120165412142771300636692956715734962527390622927714845418099553756337…** (30046 decimals; the exact value is `kappa` in `research/capped-fusion-t74-k554/outer/OUTER-CLAIM.json`, SHA-256 of the decimal string `c8ad5764d9f1eaf4f46cb506506d5c4396c8d61a2db59d6d945f16a2c8aa97a1`).

Same construction as #1928/#1905 (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion outer by Vlado Vojdanovski on the pivot-566+554 T74 supplier, with PR1786 fine source-prime padding, gauge-free interiors and the radix-distributed union schedule). New here: the supplier's complex endpoint is recertified on a 1e-30000 grid (accept at the endpoint, reject one grid step above, with the repaired even-term engines and an independent log oracle), with free strict slacks at 1e-30010. κ exceeds #1992 (rohanarun) by about 1e-10000, and #1928, #1897, #1876 and #1875 as well, all checked with exact Fraction comparisons in the ledger.

## Verification

Fresh checkout of `322949a53488d64023fedb89a6774927707e57ba`. Manifest: `236cff02c0d2358174226f69d3b5702ec151af6b5841501dd4be69963b5cd8f9`. Full package-owned `verify_release.py` returned PASS_RELEASE in 3834.3 seconds, with fresh native replays, strict T74 admission and the outer ledger.

This package includes the #1956 carried bootstrap-cutoff repair (Josie Elliston), asserted exactly at proof time, with a control showing the uncarried cutoffs fail; and #1964's extended-label (Lemma G H1) stage (thakrarsagar), where the honest programs show 0 violations and the X/Y/Z adapter mutants are rejected. All 80 T74 residual wrappers were also checked exact with #2029's two kernels (512 columns, global phase).

See `research/capped-fusion-t74-k554/README.md` and `research/capped-fusion-t74-k554/RELEASE.json` for the full summary, proof description and reproduction commands.
